steps.title: Rosa · Harbor Point Fitness: beginner exercise timetable · part 1
steps.detail: Rosa · Harbor Point Fitness asks for a beginner exercise timetable. Their evidence contains an unresolved question. What should the first draft do?

choices.label: Document the question and ask for evidence

steps.title: Rosa · Harbor Point Fitness: beginner exercise timetable · part 2
steps.detail: The beginner exercise timetable now has conflicting notes. Rosa · Harbor Point Fitness wants a version that other people can check. How do you resolve the conflict?

choices.label: Compare sources and record what remains uncertain
Keep the newest note without checking
Delete both notes to make the file look complete

steps.title: Rosa · Harbor Point Fitness: beginner exercise timetable · part 3
steps.detail: Rosa · Harbor Point Fitness is ready to introduce a paying client for the beginner exercise timetable. The client asks for a promise you cannot verify. What do you put in the handover?

choices.label: State the agreed scope, limits and evidence
Guarantee the result to win the introduction
Leave the risks out of the handover

referral.detail: A referred client commissions a documented beginner exercise timetable. Complete the agreed work; no revenue is earned merely for knowing Rosa · Harbor Point Fitness.
